description: Estimate the credit cost of make_faceless WITHOUT spending credits. Always call this first and show the user the price before make_faceless.

brief.description: What the video is about; the narration is written from it. Required when input_mode is 'brief'; must be absent when it is 'script'.

character_details.description: Optional fixed visual details for the referenced person or figure, such as hairstyle, clothing and absent accessories; applied to every generated scene.

character_reference.description: Optional public https image of a person or figure to keep consistent across scenes.

duration_seconds.description: Selected length, 30 to 90 seconds, on a 1/25 s frame boundary.

input_mode.description: 'script' narrates your exact text; 'brief' writes the narration from a short description. Send exactly one of script or brief, matching this mode.

scene_images.description: Optional images of your own, each placed at a word range or quote of the narration.

script.description: The narration, read as written. Required when input_mode is 'script'; must be absent when it is 'brief'.

style_reference.description: Optional public https image whose visual style the scenes follow.

transitions.description: Optional flash or light leak on the cuts: every scene change, or the one nearest each anchor (script only). No extra charge.

voice.description: Narration voice: a name from list_voices with skill=make_faceless (kind faceless_voice). Omitted means narrator_en_wise_lady.

name: quote_faceless
title: Quote a faceless video
